### The Altar of Incense
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/altar-incense
Passage: Exodus 30:1-10
Points:
- In the ancient Near East, incense honored kings, and God commanded fragrant incense within His earthly throne room.
- While the table and lampstand signified God's provision, the altar of incense symbolized the people's offering of prayer.
- The rising smoke penetrating past the inner veil pictured prayers entering into the very presence of heaven.
- Annual atonement on the altar's horns foreshadowed how Christ's ultimate sacrifice alone makes human prayers acceptable.
- The prohibition against unauthorized incense shows that God requires worship and prayer to be offered exclusively through Christ.
